title: Partner Sentence · Classic
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Partner Sentence · Classic with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose two players and an everyday topic. One player says a first sentence and the partner adds a second sentence that follows it. The group can understand how the second sentence follows the first. Each player takes two turns. Give the lead one point for each successful turn. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Partner Sentence, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The group can understand how the second sentence follows the first.
recall.why: The group can understand how the second sentence follows the first.
